item.title: Gemini 3 + Claude Code: Why I Prefer This Stack for Local Development
item.description: Grounded in official Google DeepMind data, this guide explains Gemini 3’s strengths in reasoning, coding, and long-context workloads, then walks through how to wire gemini-3-pro-preview into Claude Code via TokHub to build a stronger local AI development setup.
